chunks: Ibrāhīm ibn Abī Maḥmūd said to al-Riḍā عليه السلام:
A man performs salat (prayer) on a bed made of teakwood and performs sajdah (prostration) on the teakwood.

key_terms.نَعَمْ: yes; an expression of permissibility here

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform sajdah on teakwood during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling from Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام permitting salat (prayer) on a teakwood bed and sajdah (prostration) upon teakwood. It indicates the permissibility of prostrating on this type of wood within the law of prayer.
